prompt:
[quiet, tired] I kept putting the logbook off. I didn't sit down with it until ten to three.

[quiet, tense] Lily was standing at the entrance. In the rain, no umbrella. Lily was asleep two hundred miles away.

[quiet, tired] Frank's booth. A mug of unfinished tea, the jacket on the back of the chair. As if he'd stepped out for a minute. A week ago.

[quiet, uneasy] So it was his mom calling him downstairs. 'Frankie, son…' — just like the text on his phone.
